config.description: klens config file as a map. The binary validates this YAML, not the chart.
config.title: config

env.description: Extra environment variables as a map (templated).
env.title: env

existingConfigMap.description: Mount an existing ConfigMap with a `config.yaml` key instead of the inline `config`.
existingConfigMap.title: existingConfigMap

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables as a raw list (templated).
extraEnv.title: extraEnv

additionalRules.description: Custom rules prepended before the default rule (templated).
additionalRules.title: additionalRules

apiVersion.description: HTTPRoute apiVersion. Empty defaults to gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1.
apiVersion.title: apiVersion

enabled.description: Expose the UI via a Gateway API HTTPRoute.
enabled.title: enabled

filters.description: Filters applied to the default rule.
filters.title: filters

hostnames.description: Hostnames matched against the Host header (templated).
hostnames.title: hostnames

httpsRedirect.description: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS (301) instead of routing to the backend.
httpsRedirect.title: httpsRedirect

kind.description: HTTPRoute kind. Empty defaults to HTTPRoute.
kind.title: kind

matches.description: Match conditions for the default rule.
matches.title: matches

digest.description: Pin the image by digest (`sha256:…`). When set, it overrides the tag.
digest.title: digest

tag.description: Overrides the image tag. Empty uses the chart appVersion.
tag.title: tag

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries.
imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets

enabled.description: Expose the UI via an Ingress. Use a Prefix `/` path so SPA routes and `/graphql` reach the pod.
enabled.title: enabled

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe. Targets `/health` after startup succeeds.
livenessProbe.title: livenessProbe

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.
nameOverride.title: nameOverride

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass for the pod. Empty uses the cluster default.
priorityClassName.title: priorityClassName

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe. Targets `/ready` after every configured cluster has a catalog snapshot.
readinessProbe.title: readinessProbe

replicaCount.description: Replica count. Sessions live in process memory and do not stick across pods.
replicaCount.title: replicaCount

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret whose keys are injected as environment variables.
existingSecret.title: existingSecret

stringData.description: Inline Secret keys. Ignored when `existingSecret` is set.
stringData.title: stringData

securityContext.description: Container securityContext (no privilege escalation, read-only root, drop ALL).
securityContext.title: securityContext

port.description: Service port. Must match the port in `config.bind` when the chart owns the ConfigMap.
port.title: port

automount.description: Automount the ServiceAccount API token. Off because klens does not call the Kubernetes API.
automount.title: automount

name.description: ServiceAccount name. Empty uses the chart fullname.
name.title: name

startupProbe.description: Startup probe. Targets `/health` until the process binds.
startupProbe.title: startupProbe

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period for a clean shutdown.
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: terminationGracePeriodSeconds

repository.description: `helm test` connection-pod image. A gcr-mirrored curl so the test never pulls from Docker Hub.
repository.title: repository

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts on the container.
volumeMounts.title: volumeMounts

volumes.description: Additional volumes on the Deployment. Use these for Kafka TLS PEMs. Set Secret `defaultMode` to 0400 so the client key is not group- or world-readable.
volumes.title: volumes
